title: The Lalbagh Glass House Mystery
subtitle: Who attacked Basavanna?
blurb: It’s August 31st—two weeks after Lalbagh’s Independence Day Flower Show. Basavanna, a meddlesome Bangalore socialite and gossip blogger, has vanished near the lake path, leaving only a broken black umbrella and a spilled brass tumbler of filter coffee. Check this page for updates, then open your sealed character card when the host says so.
